verdict.rationale: Mangopay is documented as an API-first platform: it has a Sandbox API covering all features, official SDKs for Node.js, PHP, Python, .NET, Java and Ruby, and webhooks for event notifications. A probe confirmed a public OpenAPI spec at docs.mangopay.com/openapi.json and an llms.txt with instructions for AI agents. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of real API usage beyond the existence of the spec.
